rows.grounds: verb ās, third singular present ātmanepada
compound strī plus niṣevaka, masculine nominative plural

items.question: Who among practitioners is called a woman-servant?
premises: Sexual union defines a practitioner class.
The verse classifies conduct by label.
items.inference: A man who performs sexual union is grouped among women-servants.
uncertainties: Exact scope of apare is unclear.
Whether tat refers to act or person is unclear.
items.plain_english: He who performs sexual union—that would be [counted among] the others, the women-servants.
